mapper.select: SELECT t.owner_id,t.id AS task_id,t.purpose,t.status,t.current_attempt_id,t.attempt_count, e.owner_id AS binding_owner_id,e.task_id AS binding_task_id,e.session_id,e.question_id,e.answer_id, a.owner_id AS attempt_owner_id,a.task_id AS attempt_task_id,a.id AS attempt_id, a.attempt_number,a.status AS attempt_status, r.owner_id AS answer_owner_id,r.session_id AS answer_session_id,r.question_id AS answer_question_id, r.id AS actual_answer_id,r.version_number AS answer_number,r.answer_condition FROM ai_task t LEFT JOIN ai_evaluation e ON e.owner_id=t.owner_id AND e.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN ai_attempt a ON a.owner_id=t.owner_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.id=t.current_attempt_id LEFT JOIN training_answer r ON r.owner_id=e.owner_id AND r.session_id=e.session_id AND r.question_id=e.question_id AND r.id=e.answer_id WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND t.id=#{taskId}
SELECT owner_id,id AS task_id,candidate_json FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{taskId}
SELECT owner_id,task_id,feedback_id,id,revision,choice FROM ai_feedback_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND feedback_id=#{feedbackId} AND revision=#{revision}
